Plantforum is a wholesale seedling nursery based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, specialising in vegetable, flower and herb seedlings alongside cuttings, ornamentals, micro greens and edible flowers. The nursery also produces its own compost and fertiliser in-house, supporting its seedling production rather than relying only on bought-in inputs.

Its main business is supplying commercial growers with seedlings and cuttings at the volumes a working farm or market garden needs, though small orders are available to members of the public on Fridays and Saturdays. Based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, Plantforum suits commercial vegetable and flower growers needing seedlings at scale, as well as home gardeners able to visit on the weekend collection days.

Plastilon Packaging Silver Lakes is a branch of the Plastilon Packaging chain trading from the Six Fountains Lifestyle Centre, with this branch having traded for over 41 years. The store stocks a diversified range of commercial and industrial packaging, including bags, bottles, boxes, buckets, crates and drums, alongside cleaning and chemical products.

Beyond packaging, the branch also sells gift-wrapping supplies, party supplies, kitchenware and stationery, giving it a wider retail offering than a typical packaging wholesaler. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based in Six Fountains Residential Estate, Pretoria, this branch suits both businesses needing bulk packaging supplies and households needing gift-wrapping, party or stationery items from the same store.

Pool Solutions Epoxy Coatings has supplied and applied epoxy pool paint since 1998, now with over 28 years in the industry, from its base in Die Wilgers, Pretoria. Its ProShield system is a specialised four-layer epoxy coating manufactured in-house, engineered to handle the harsh, chemically rich, fully submerged conditions inside a swimming pool.

The product is available as a DIY application kit or applied by the company's own registered contractors, backed by a standard three-year warranty with an optional extended five-year warranty for DIY customers. A related light-industrial epoxy floor coating, developed from the same pool-paint system, is available for garage floors and industrial spaces. The business is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, it suits homeowners wanting to resurface and waterproof a swimming pool as well as those needing a durable epoxy floor coating.

PostNet Laudium is a branch of the national PostNet retail network, trading from Shop G2 in the Jhina Centre on 6th Avenue, Laudium. The branch offers courier, copying and printing, stationery and digital business services, and also operates as a DHL Service Point for local and international parcel shipping.

As part of the wider PostNet network of stores across South Africa, the branch can draw on nationwide courier partnerships and standardised printing and business services while still operating as a local, walk-in store. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:45pm, Saturdays from 9am to 2:30pm and public holidays from 9am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based in Laudium, Pretoria, PostNet Laudium suits individuals and small businesses needing courier, printing or stationery services from a local branch of a trusted national network.

PostNet Lyttelton is a branch of the national PostNet network, trading from Shop 15 inside The Highlands Shopping Centre at the corner of Rabie and Glover Streets, Lyttelton. The branch offers copying and printing, domestic and international courier services, stationery and digital business solutions, along with professional mailbox services for customers needing a business address.

As part of the broader PostNet franchise, the branch benefits from nationwide courier partnerships and standardised services while operating as a local, walk-in store for the Lyttelton area. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, with shorter hours on Sundays and public holidays. Based in Lyttelton, Centurion, PostNet Lyttelton suits individuals and small businesses needing courier, printing, stationery or mailbox services close to home.

PostNet Midstream (Centurion) is a courier, copy and print outlet based at the Square@Midstream centre in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein. The branch offers A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges and rubber stamps, alongside stationery, packaging material and courier services.

The branch also sells Vox internet packages and builds websites for local customers, extending its offering beyond the standard PostNet print-and-courier service. It trades on weekdays from 8am to 6pm and on Saturday mornings from 9am to 2pm, closed Sundays and public holidays. Based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, PostNet Midstream suits residents and businesses in the estate needing printing, courier or basic connectivity services close to home.

PostNet Pretoria North (Ninapark) is a branch of the national PostNet retail network, located in the Northdale Shopping Centre on Grafenheim Street, Ninapark, Akasia. The branch offers courier, copying and printing services typical of the PostNet network, giving local customers a nearby point for sending parcels or printing documents without travelling into central Pretoria.

As part of the wider PostNet franchise, the branch benefits from the group's nationwide courier partnerships and standardised printing and business services while operating as a local, walk-in store for the Ninapark area. It trades on weekdays from 8am to 6pm and Saturday mornings from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based in Ninapark, Akasia, PostNet Pretoria North suits residents and small businesses in the area needing courier, copy and print services close to home.

Pretoria Gates & Fences manufactures and installs custom gates, fences, carports and steel structures for customers across Pretoria, working from its base in East Lynne. The company's range includes electric fences, automated gate motors and intercom systems, covering both the physical barrier and the automation and access-control side of a property's perimeter security.

Alongside new installations, the business offers same-day repairs, useful for customers dealing with a gate motor or electric fence fault that needs fixing quickly rather than waiting days for a technician. Based in East Lynne, Pretoria, Pretoria Gates & Fences suits homeowners and businesses needing gates, fencing, carports or steel structures manufactured and installed by one local company, with repairs on call when something breaks.

Pretoria WISP is an independent wireless internet service provider based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, offering uncapped Wi-Fi and fibre-like connectivity to homes, businesses, estates and complexes. Its packages run uncapped and unshaped with no fair-use policy and no fixed-term contracts, and the provider offers direct technical support rather than routing customers through a call centre.

The network is actively expanding into the Hazeldean Valley area, including Zwavelpoort, Tyger Valley, Mooiplaats, Donkerhoek, Shere and Boschkop, bringing fibre-like speeds to homes and businesses where trenched fibre infrastructure isn't available. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Pretoria WISP suits residents, estates and complexes in areas without practical fibre access who still want a reliable, high-speed internet connection.

Pride Milling (Head Office) manufactures, markets and distributes white and yellow maize products, in both GMO and GMO-free lines, for commercial and industrial customers from Highveld Techno Park, Centurion. The company's range runs from bulk maize meal and industrial maize products through to consumer-facing instant maize and sorghum porridges, pulses, legumes and grains, and snack products.

With 20 years of experience, Pride Milling exports its maize and maize-based products, along with beans, pulses, sorghum products, nuts, grains and bird seed, to international markets, and holds B-BBEE Level 1 certification along with recognised food-safety and quality-management standards. Based in Highveld, Centurion, the head office suits commercial and industrial buyers across South Africa and export markets needing certified maize and grain products at scale.

Pro Pure Water supplies bulk and bottled drinking water plus water cooler rentals from its premises in Villieria, Pretoria, delivering to offices, factories, nurseries and restaurants in bottle sizes ranging up to 1000-litre drums. Its water is tested for compliance by independent laboratories against the South African National Standard SANS 241:2015, covering microbiological, chemical, acute health and aesthetic compliance.

The company also offers personalised bottled water with custom labelling, water cooler contracts for offices, and water testing packages for customers wanting to check their own water quality. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm. Based in Riviera, Pretoria, Pro Pure Water suits businesses and households across the city needing a tested, affordable bulk water supply rather than relying on municipal tap water alone.

Pro Quartz manufactures engineered quartz and sintered-stone surfaces from its premises in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, blending around 93% natural quartz with resins and pigments to create a non-porous stone that is harder than granite or marble. Its product range covers ProQuartz engineered quartz, SIGMAquartz and the large-format EstrellaSA sintered stone tiles, used for countertops, flooring, vanities, wall cladding and staircases.

The company backs its ranges with warranties running from 10 years on the EstrellaSA sintered stone up to a lifetime limited warranty on the ProQuartz Premier range, reflecting more than 30 years of research behind the product. Based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, Pro Quartz suits homeowners, architects and contractors wanting a durable, low-maintenance stone surface for kitchens, bathrooms or commercial interiors.

Pro-Video International has operated as a film, video and audio production company in Roseville, Pretoria, since 1997, holding a Level 2 BEE status. The company produces corporate training videos, school event videos, health and safety videos, live event filming, and website and YouTube video content with live streaming capability.

Its services extend to music video production and animation and motion graphics, giving clients a range of visual content beyond standard corporate filming. Working with corporates, government bodies, NGOs, schools and advertising agencies, Pro-Video International has built relationships across several sectors rather than specialising in a single type of client. Based in Roseville, Pretoria, the company suits organisations needing professional video, audio or photographic production handled by an established local team.

ProCM - The Owners' Team is a construction and project management consultancy established in 2011 and based in Southdowns, Irene, Centurion, focused on the mining and food-and-beverage sectors. The firm positions itself as a bridge between a project's engineering and construction teams, managing roles such as design, project planning, budgeting, procurement, construction management and risk analysis so the two sides of a project stay coordinated.

Acting as part of the client's own Owners' Team rather than as an outside contractor, ProCM aims to prevent the miscommunication and disconnection that can occur between large project and construction teams, working to deliver a client's primary goals rather than just completing a scope of work. Based in Southdowns, Centurion, the consultancy suits mining and food-and-beverage sector clients needing experienced project and construction management oversight on complex projects.

Professor Building Construction Gauteng is a construction company based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria, serving clients across Pretoria, Centurion and Johannesburg. The business takes on new-build and repair work, bricklaying and masonry, and plastering, covering both ground-up construction and smaller structural repair jobs on homes and other buildings.

Alongside its construction services, the company also supplies building materials, giving clients the option to source bricks, cement and other supplies from the same business handling the building work, rather than arranging a separate materials supplier. Based in Proclamation Hill, Pretoria, Professor Building Construction Gauteng suits homeowners and developers across the wider Pretoria-Centurion-Johannesburg corridor needing bricklaying, masonry, plastering or general building work from a single contractor.

Profound Project Control Solutions is a project-control software and consulting provider based in Clubview, Centurion, that has, since 1998, supplied engineering, procurement, construction and manufacturing companies with project cost, procurement and document-control software. The company's offering is built around Acumatica ERP, giving clients a single integrated financial, inventory and project cost-control system rather than several disconnected tools for invoices, budgets, timecards and project data.

The business has since expanded into SAGE 300 People payroll and HR solutions, including outsourced payroll and HR services for clients who want that function managed externally. Based in Clubview, Centurion, Profound Project Control Solutions suits project-based companies needing real-time financial and project information alongside compliant, well-managed payroll.

PropWorx is a cloud-based property management software provider based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, with roots dating back to 2004, giving estate agents, landlords and franchisors tools for managing rentals, sales, trust accounting, maintenance and inspections. Its lease and rental management tools track all property types across a central system, with an integrated CRM for bulk emails and SMS to tenants, leads and service providers, plus owner and tenant portal access and automated statements.

On the sales side, the platform tracks a sale from offer to lodgement, with its own CRM for buyers, sellers and attorneys and automated sales reports, invoices and commission breakdowns. An integrated property accounting suite handles bank account tracking, multiple cashbooks and reconciliations. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, PropWorx suits estate agencies, landlords and franchise groups wanting rental, sales and trust accounting managed on one platform.

Protector Build Wonderboom deals in second-hand and reclaimed building materials, including bricks, doors, windows, roofing and timber, and also offers demolition and salvage services, with the group's roots going back to 1987. What began as a small business trading second-hand construction supplies has grown into a group of companies spanning sales, salvage and demolition across Pretoria and Midrand.

Buying and selling reclaimed materials rather than only new stock lets customers source building materials more affordably, while the group's demolition and salvage arm gives it a steady supply of stock to resell. Based in Rooiwal, near Onderstepoort, Pretoria, Protector Build Wonderboom suits builders, renovators and DIY customers across Gauteng looking for quality second-hand building materials or demolition and salvage services.

Pulpit Media Group, established in May 2014 and based in Kilner Park, Pretoria, mobilises several Christian media organisations under one umbrella, including the long-running Radio Pulpit 657AM and its sister station Cape Pulpit 729AM. The group was formed to create optimal synergy, joint co-operation and cost-effective operations between these related Christian media organisations and ministries.

By bringing several Christian media outlets together under a single group structure, Pulpit Media Group aims to spread Christian content and values across South Africa more effectively than each organisation could achieve alone. Based in Kilner Park, Pretoria, the group suits listeners and partner ministries looking for an established, coordinated Christian media presence on radio and other platforms.

Pulpits RSA designs and manufactures pulpits, podiums and lecterns for churches and other institutions from its base in Val de Grace, Pretoria. All of its products are locally designed and made using quality materials and skilled workmanship, rather than imported, and logos or wording can be printed directly onto a piece as part of the order.

Customers can order from available stock or place a pre-order with an estimated five to seven day lead time, and artwork for a custom logo can be supplied by the client or designed by Pulpits RSA at an additional cost. Payment options include cash on collection, or deposit-based instalment plans spread over four, eight or twelve weeks, with collection from the workshop or courier arranged nationwide and internationally. Based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, Pulpits RSA suits churches, conference venues and other institutions needing a locally made pulpit, podium or lectern.

Purple Surgical South Africa is the local sales office of Purple Surgical, a British manufacturer of single-use surgical instruments and devices, based at Byls Bridge Office Park in Doringkloof, Centurion. The group's product range covers laparoscopic procedure kits and trays, operating theatre essentials, gynaecological essentials and Bluesail surgical staplers, trusted by healthcare providers in the UK and more than 60 countries worldwide.

Its laparoscopic kits and trays are fully customisable, designed to reduce clinical variation and improve efficiency by consolidating orders and streamlining inventory for hospitals and surgical units. As a single-use instrument manufacturer, the group also emphasises environmentally responsible manufacturing alongside clinical performance. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, Purple Surgical South Africa serves hospitals, clinics and surgical teams across the region needing reliable single-use surgical instruments.

Pvr Auto Repairs is an automotive workshop based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, offering general service and maintenance, brake, clutch and gearbox repairs, diagnostics, suspension and steering work, and air-conditioning and heating repairs. The workshop also provides mobile mechanic call-outs for customers who can't bring their vehicle in, along with tyre, wheel and alignment work and windscreen and mirror repairs.

The business positions itself as a practical option for customers needing reliable repairs without the overheads of a large dealership workshop. It is open Monday to Thursday from 9am to 4:30pm and Friday from 9am to 3pm, closed weekends. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, Pvr Auto Repairs suits drivers across the area needing everyday servicing or mechanical repairs from a local, independent workshop.

Realty Link is an independent real estate agency based in Queenswood, Pretoria, specialising in property sales and rentals. The agency manages a portfolio of residential listings for sale and to let across the greater Pretoria area, with new properties added regularly across suburbs including Lynnwood, La Montagne, Riviera, Wapadrand, Eastwood, Gezina and Die Hoewes.

Being independent rather than part of a large national franchise lets the agency focus on direct relationships with buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants rather than operating under a big-brand structure. Based in Queenswood, Pretoria, Realty Link suits buyers and sellers across the greater Pretoria area looking for a locally run estate agency handling both sales and rental listings.

Red September is an independently owned, full-service advertising and digital marketing agency founded in 2011, based at The Aviary in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria. The agency combines brand strategy, creative campaigns, social media, media planning and marketing technology, with service lines spanning strategy and growth, creative and content, social and influence, media buying, martech and automation, and digital development.

Its client list includes major automotive brands such as Honda, Mahindra and Mitsubishi, and the agency has picked up industry award recognition for campaigns including data-driven insight and customer acquisition work. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Red September suits established brands needing an integrated advertising partner covering strategy, creative, media and digital technology under one agency.

Reniers Electrical and Solar Solutions is an electrical and solar contractor based in Bergtuin, Pretoria, offering solar system and inverter installations, upgrades and fault-finding alongside general electrical repairs. The company also issues Certificate of Compliance inspections for property sales, a legal requirement for South African homeowners selling a property with electrical work.

Its stated approach runs through consultation, planning and approval, implementation, and a final inspection and certification stage, aiming for a transparent process on both solar and electrical jobs. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, closed weekends. Based in Bergtuin, Pretoria, Reniers Electrical and Solar Solutions suits homeowners needing solar installation, electrical repairs or a Certificate of Compliance ahead of a property sale.

Retro Rabbit is a design-first, technology-agnostic digital consultancy based in Shere, Pretoria, building custom software, UX/UI design and digital products including its own Smartboxx AI offering. The consultancy combines user experience design, software engineering, AI enablement and digital strategy, aiming to handle the technical complexity of a project so clients can focus on growth and customer outcomes.

Its client list spans South Africa's major banking and insurance groups, including ABSA, Nedbank, FNB, Standard Bank, Capitec, Discovery and Momentum, reflecting experience building secure, scalable systems for highly regulated industries. Services cover software engineering, UX/UI design, digital design across web and mobile, and technical testing and QA. Based in Shere, Pretoria, Retro Rabbit suits larger organisations, particularly in banking and insurance, needing a design-led technology partner rather than a pure code shop.

Riken is a South African supplier of low-voltage AC and DC electrical products, with its head office in Pretoria and branches in the Eastern and Western Cape. Operating for over 40 years, the company has built its name as a trusted brand in low-voltage electrical products and innovative technical solutions across Southern Africa.

The company backs its product range with extended warranties and a national footprint, giving customers access to support and stock beyond their immediate region. It is open Monday to Thursday from 7:30am to 5pm and Friday from 7:30am to 3pm. Based at Guernsey Business Park in Irene, Pretoria, Riken suits electrical contractors, wholesalers and retailers across South Africa needing an established low-voltage electrical products supplier.

ROD Marketing is a full-service marketing and branding agency based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, offering brand strategy, content marketing, SEO and digital marketing, photography and videography, and website design and development. The agency builds a marketing plan around a client's brand before producing supporting content, aiming for a coordinated strategy across copy, imagery and video rather than ad hoc individual pieces.

Its videography and photography services are built to support corporate video and animation content as well as product and brand photography, ensuring visual content matches the agency's written copy and strategy. Based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, ROD Marketing suits businesses wanting brand strategy, content, SEO and visual production handled by a single marketing agency.

RPRSA Waterproofing & Roof Repairs provides waterproofing, roof repairs, roof spray painting and damp-proofing services for residential, commercial and industrial properties across Pretoria, Centurion and Midrand, backed by more than 11 years of industry experience. All work is carried out to the South African Bureau of Standards SABS 4545 standard, using the company's own self-engineered products alongside established waterproofing techniques.

The business is backed by a team of more than 25 skilled professionals, including site managers and directors, and offers workmanship and materials guarantees on particular jobs and products used. It is open Monday to Saturday from 6am to 6pm. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, RPRSA suits property owners across Pretoria, Centurion and Midrand needing certified waterproofing, roof repair or damp-proofing work with a guarantee behind it.

RR Glass manufactures and installs high-end aluminium, stainless steel and glass products from its premises in Monavoni, Centurion, including frameless glass, glass balustrades, aluminium windows and doors, and double glazing. The company serves developers, contractors, architects and other construction-industry professionals, positioning its products for projects that need a higher specification finish than standard building materials.

Its frameless glass and glass-processing services are built for both commercial and residential spaces, aiming for a precise, seamless finish that blends indoor and outdoor areas. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm. Based in Monavoni, Centurion, RR Glass suits developers, architects and homeowners needing custom aluminium, glass or stainless steel work manufactured and installed by a specialist rather than a general glazier.

RSD Construction and Maintenance provides home maintenance and repair services from its base in Clubview East, Centurion, covering electrical and plumbing work, carpentry, landscaping and general handyman jobs. The company also offers interior design input for clients wanting their maintenance or renovation work to fit a broader design plan rather than just fixing what's broken.

The business is registered with the NHBRC, the body that regulates home building standards in South Africa, giving clients a registered contractor for both maintenance work and any larger building projects. Based in Clubview East, Centurion, RSD Construction and Maintenance suits homeowners needing electrical, plumbing, carpentry or general handyman work handled by one registered contractor rather than several separate tradespeople.

Rumas provides revenue management software and consulting for local government and utility organisations from its offices in Persequor, Pretoria, with over 20 years of experience developing business solutions in the utility environment. Its software covers automated revenue and credit control, debt collection, indigent management specific to the South African context, technical maintenance scheduling for infrastructure, and a communication module for sending and receiving messages.

The company's mobile technology integrates with its other applications, giving field staff real-time status updates and letting them geo-reference and record infrastructure information through stand audits and general inspections. Rumas also offers consulting services including business and debtor-book analysis and credit control process reviews. Based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, Rumas suits municipalities and utility providers needing both the software and the consulting expertise to improve revenue collection.

Ruvimbo Group (Pty) Ltd is an environmental consulting firm based in Heatherview, Akasia, offering environmental management and compliance services alongside specialist impact studies. The firm works on ecological restoration of land affected by mining or development activities, aiming to return disturbed land to a sustainable, usable condition.

Its services also cover support for infrastructure development projects at every stage, from planning and implementation through to operation, decommissioning and rehabilitation, giving clients continuity of environmental advice across a project's full life cycle. Based in Heatherview, Akasia, Ruvimbo Group suits mining companies, developers and infrastructure project owners needing environmental compliance, impact studies or land rehabilitation expertise.

S E Solutions (Pty) Ltd is an environmental consulting firm based in Zwartkop, Centurion, offering compliance assurance services to help businesses meet environmental legal requirements. Its strategic advisory service focuses on crafting sustainable environmental solutions for specific challenges, helping companies navigate both social and environmental compliance obligations.

The firm's specialist services cover air quality management, EIA project management and environmental management training, drawing on specialists across both the social and environmental domains as needed. Its environmental assessment work spans basic assessments, scoping, environmental impact reports and strategic and regional environmental and social assessments tailored to specific regulatory and lender requirements. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, S E Solutions suits businesses navigating environmental legislation that need assessment, compliance and training handled by one specialist firm.

SA Plastikor manufactures, imports and distributes water pumps, irrigation systems and reverse-osmosis, nanofiltration and UV water-purification equipment, together with PVC and HDPE pipe, fittings and valves, from its premises in Pretoria North. Founded in 1969, the company started out focused on plastic injection moulding and extruding polymers before growing into a wholesale distributor for water pumps, irrigation and water filtration equipment, with an additional office in Cape Town.

Its product range covers brands including Azud, Rain Bird, Conforto, DAB, Franklin and Seakoo, serving homes, farms, parks, sports fields and commercial applications. The company positions its equipment as part of the solution to South Africa's water scarcity, helping customers reduce water waste through better irrigation and pump management. Based in Pretoria North, SA Plastikor suits farms, parks, sports facilities and commercial sites needing pumps, irrigation or water purification equipment and fittings.

SA PrimeLink is a business-support firm based in Lyttelton, Centurion, offering branding and corporate-gifting solutions alongside company and vehicle business registration number (BRN) services. The firm also assists with COIDA, CSD and CIDB compliance, helping businesses meet the registration and compliance requirements needed to tender for government and corporate work.

Beyond compliance and registrations, SA PrimeLink offers business planning, bookkeeping and equipment hire, giving smaller businesses access to several back-office functions from one supplier rather than separate accountants, compliance consultants and hire companies. It is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed Sundays. Based in Lyttelton, Centurion, SA PrimeLink suits small and medium businesses needing registration, compliance and basic back-office support handled in one place.

Santa's Warehouse Pretoria is a year-round Christmas store based in Shere, Pretoria, established in 2000 and expanded into a full warehouse by 2014. The store sells ornaments, including a range of nutcrackers in different sizes, lighting, artificial trees, tree decor, wreaths and garlands, and festive apparel.

Describing itself as South Africa's biggest year-round Christmas store, the business lets customers shop for Christmas decor at any time of year rather than only during the festive retail season. Based in Shere, Pretoria, Santa's Warehouse suits households, event decorators and businesses wanting a wide range of Christmas decor and ornaments available outside the usual seasonal shopping window.

Sapphire Industrial Supplier distributes transformer raw materials and accessories, sealing products, valves, hoses and couplings to the energy and industrial sectors, established in 2008 and based in Villieria, Pretoria. The company supplies South Africa, the wider SADC region and international markets through a network of distribution partners, working from its head office and warehouse in Pretoria.

Alongside its product range, Sapphire Industrial Supplier offers hands-on technical support, aiming to listen to a customer's specific requirements rather than simply filling a generic order. The company works to a stated objective of distributing high-quality products throughout the region within a specified timeframe, with a strong commitment to customer requirements. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, Sapphire Industrial Supplier suits businesses in the energy, renewable energy and industrial sectors needing transformer materials, sealing products or valves from a dedicated regional distributor.

Sasol Theresa Park is a fuel station in Theresapark, Akasia, offering unleaded and premium diesel fuel alongside a convenience store. The station stocks Halaal food options for customers looking for certified products, and houses a Vida e Caffe outlet for coffee and light snacks while refuelling or stopping over.

The station also runs a 24-hour car wash, letting customers get their vehicle washed outside normal daytime hours. As part of the national Sasol fuel network, the station benefits from the group's fuel supply and loyalty programme while operating as a local, everyday stop for the Theresapark area. Based at the corner of Rachel De Beer and Waterbok Streets in Theresapark, Akasia, Sasol Theresa Park suits motorists needing fuel, a quick meal or a car wash along their route.

Seek Security is a Centurion-based security company founded by the Orren family in 2019, offering armed response, guarding and VIP protection alongside vehicle tracking and high-risk escort services. The company also carries out investigations and runs 24-hour alarm and CCTV monitoring for its clients.

Describing itself as a family business built around trust and a relentless pursuit of excellence, the company positions its team as seasoned security professionals selected for their expertise and integrity. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, Seek Security suits homeowners and businesses needing a locally based, family-run security provider covering everything from armed response to VIP protection.

Self Storage operates a facility in Zwavelpoort among its sites across Pretoria East, using sealed, converted shipping containers to keep stored goods dust-free and protected from water damage. Security includes armed response, 24-hour camera surveillance and floodlighting, along with access to the storage unit 365 days a year.

The minimum rental period is one month, with no fixed limit on how long a unit can be rented, and a range of unit sizes available at what the company describes as reasonable rates on clean, well-maintained premises. It is open daily from 7am to 6pm. Based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria East, Self Storage suits households and businesses needing secure, flexible self-storage without a long-term lease commitment.

Sense Business Systems is a compliance consultancy based in Sinoville, Pretoria, run by attorneys and accountants advising on corporate governance and anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorism financing framework management. The firm also handles POPI compliance and B-BBEE and skills-development transformation work, helping businesses meet the compliance pressure coming from regulators, consumers and other stakeholders.

Clients can book a short, no-obligation compliance evaluation with the firm's team before committing to a longer engagement, and ongoing training is delivered through the firm's own Sense Campus platform rather than outsourced to a separate training provider. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, Sense Business Systems suits businesses that want compliance, governance and transformation work handled by subject matter experts rather than stretching an internal team across all of it.

Seven Pebbles Purified Water uses a seven-stage purification process, including reverse osmosis, ozone injection and UV exposure, to produce purified drinking water from its premises near the Northdale Shopping Centre area. Alongside standard purified water, the company offers alkaline water, whose pH level comes from alkaline minerals such as calcium, potassium, magnesium and iron, and mineral or "zest" water with essential salts added back in for customers with a physically active lifestyle.

Supplying water that has gone through all seven purification stages rather than a single filtration step is the company's core differentiator, aimed at removing contaminants, pathogens and impurities that can pose health risks in untreated water sources. Based in Florauna, Pretoria, Seven Pebbles Purified Water suits households and businesses wanting purified, alkaline or mineral drinking water from a dedicated local producer.

SHE RUNS DIGITAL is a faith-based software and IT services business based in La Montagne, Pretoria, founded in 2020 and describing itself as a Spirit-led SaaS ministry. The company builds custom web and mobile applications and database development work, alongside a set of in-house SaaS products built around digital safety, including identity-theft protection, data security and asset-protection systems.

The business has served more than 150 clients and delivered over 500 projects to date, combining standard software development work with products specifically designed to safeguard people's identity, data and assets online. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, SHE RUNS DIGITAL suits individuals, businesses and ministries looking for custom software development from a provider whose in-house products focus specifically on digital identity and asset protection.

SHE RUNS DIGITAL (PTY) LTD is a digital services company based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, founded in 2020 and built around what it describes as Spirit-led, Christ-inspired technology. Its core work covers custom web and mobile application development and database development, delivered alongside a set of in-house SaaS products focused on digital protection.

Those in-house products include identity theft and protection systems, data security platforms and asset protection systems, designed to guard individuals, businesses and communities against digital deception and data loss. The company has delivered more than 500 projects for over 150 clients to date. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, SHE RUNS DIGITAL (PTY) LTD suits clients wanting custom development work from a provider that also builds its own dedicated identity and data-protection software.

SimaCab manufactures steel double-cab canopies for pickup trucks, including models for the Isuzu D-Max, Nissan Navara, Toyota Hilux, Ford Ranger Raptor, VW Amarok and Haval P-Series, from its base in Derdepoort, Montana. Each canopy is built from durable steel designed to resist wind and weather while holding its appeal and rust resistance over time, with sleek, straight support arms for a consistent look across vehicle brands.

Canopies are available with or without a genuine VSG laminated safety-glass cover, which retains its clarity over the long term while withstanding heavy loads. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, SimaCab suits bakkie owners wanting a steel canopy built for their specific vehicle model rather than a generic, one-size-fits-all cover.
